title: W7 V -- Final check: Chromium + native, docs merge, app build
description: Read AGENTS.md, team/PROTOCOL.md, docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/REQUEST.md. Brief: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui6-brief.md. Never commit. One pass, serial lock: tsc, npm test, npm run build, full Playwright on a private config (port 1939, scratch ui7-v), cargo test, then native smoke/reliability/gates/screens plain and color. Native screens force their window to the front on the active monitor and expect 13 states now, so run them with the Mac unattended and unlocked, and tell the owner first; touch src-tauri/src/lib.rs before smoke and release builds. Native WebKit must check the row-hover rail growth, unboxed dropdowns, floating alignment and hug, hierarchy colours, ruler at zoom, Cite here focus. Merge docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/notes/*.md into docs/*.md. Build with npm run tauri build, record sha256. Write docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/VALIDATION.md with a hand-check line per request item. Read every new PNG. Do not bump the version or publish: the owner decides.

handoff.text: Small: VALIDATION.md edits only, no rerun needed. Results table matches the logs and native is honestly not run; docs/*.md wording already fixed by the reviewer. Fix: (1) Hand-check 12 is wrong: 'open a source' opens the ordinary Research panel, whose Cite here focuses the footnote field by design, so the owner would see a false failure. Replace with: 'Cite here: with floating on, in a window wide enough that the card shows, click the Research heading, choose Enter manually, press Cite here. The cursor should be in the card's Page field, not in the footnote.' (2) Line 39 'expect 13 states' becomes 26. (3) Release section: folio sha is now cdb427169c13736a5bb5dc116003a6421a3d0b5fcaabfcc48b8bdca326b6df72 (coordinator rebuild, 07:58 local, release2.log), not 0a43b22b. (4) Line 22 harness coverage is stale (T242 wrote it, never run). (5) Line 78 'before T241': the full run had T241's first rule, not the fix; only tests/editor-toolbar.spec.ts ran on the fix (ui7-rv-final/run.log). (6) Hand-check 7: 'should still have boxes'. Exact wording: docs/agent-work/2026-11-04-ui-wave-7/REVIEW-r3.md, Final. Nothing else in T240 is wrong.
